mapper.update: UPDATE message_stat SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{systemUserId} WHERE stat_date = #{statDate} AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_stat ( total_send_count, total_success_count, billing_cost, max_cost, stat_date, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT NVL(SUM(sh.total_target_count), 0), NVL(SUM(sh.success_count), 0), NVL(SUM(sh.actual_cost), 0), NVL(SUM(sh.estimated_cost), 0), #{statDate}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM send_history sh WHERE sh.status = 'SENT' AND TRUNC(sh.completed_at) = #{statDate} AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0
